items.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
items.summary_1line: Yesterday was Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) and MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( more pelicans ). Today Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 , and around an hour later OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna . It's going to take a while...
items.why_it_matters: Matches feed focus: agentic, codex, claude code.
items.editor_note: Simon Willison's same-day roundup: Claude Opus 5.5 ships, then GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna about an hour later, framed as a new price war.

editorial.tldr: Zhipu's GLM-5.3-Flash undercut Claude and GPT on price using domestic chips in late August, and Anthropic answered Sep 2 with a 75% cache-price cut and 70% more output tokens on Fable/Mythos 5.1. T. Rowe Price then publicized broad Claude adoption across its investment process on Sep 10.
editorial.whats_new: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 on Sep 22, and about an hour later OpenAI answered with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna -- Simon Willison frames the same-day releases as a new price war, not just a capability race.
editorial.why_it_matters: Same-day flagship launches from both labs mean whichever pricing and rate limits you pinned evals to last week may already be stale -- check current price sheets before trusting last month's cost comparisons.
editorial.take_for_builders: Re-price your Claude vs. GPT cost model now that Opus 5.5 and Sol/Luna are both live -- don't assume last month's per-token numbers still hold, and re-check T. Rowe Price's case study only as a vendor-risk data point, not a pricing signal.

status.detail: Anthropic's Sep 2 cache-price cut held through T. Rowe Price's Sep 10 adoption case study; on Sep 22 Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI answered within about an hour with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, which Simon Willison frames as a new price war rather than a one-off release.
